answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit bond and publishes one forecast: a range forecast of next tide's river deliveries, key-sealed on the summit board. At close the summit board publishes the realized river tide count for recompute: inside the range releases the bond, outside it burns the bond. The k-th forecast pays 20+3(k-1), so the 1000th pays 3017 and 1,000 fakes pay 1,518,500 in fees plus 80,000 locked, a quadratic total, no batch discount. A rented-forecast ring fails: copied ranges share one error, so duplicates forfeit both bonds. An honest forecaster pays 80 plus 20 once.
